_notes: Tunable wave-system parameters (SCRUM-90). Values come from the defaults written in the Jira stories; 0 means a placeholder still waiting for balance values (SCRUM-96). Percentages are fractions (0.25 = 25 %). A file with the same name in Application.persistentDataPath overrides these values without a new build.

satisfaction._source: SCRUM-43, SCRUM-44; rating_thresholds are the 6 values listed in SCRUM-44, lowest first

rewards._source: SCRUM-45; one multiplier and one Energy amount per rating, same order as rating_thresholds

buildings._source: SCRUM-50; upgrade_prices[i] is the Coins price of upgrading from level i+1 to level i+2
